Name: Muted Seeds
Author: Kayyteee
Description:
I wanted to make a little mod that changes the appearance of the seed packets to match my modded save. If you want a more town down look for your seeds this mod might work for you. 

[b][u]Others mod needed: [/u][/b]
-Content Patcher 
-SMAPI

Just place the folder '[CP] Muted Seeds' into your mod folder and thats it :D
